mapper.select: SELECT ocolt.*, ocot.resource_type FROM om_cloud_optimizer_log_tbl ocolt LEFT JOIN om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot on ocolt.resource_no = ocot.resource_no WHERE ocolt.resource_no = #{resource_no} ORDER BY ocolt.rgstr_dt DESC

WITH Subquery AS ( SELECT rgstr_date, count(*) as cnt, LAG(rgstr_date) OVER (ORDER BY rgstr_date) as previous FROM om_cloud_resource_log_tbl WHERE resource_no = #{resource_no} GROUP BY rgstr_date ) SELECT s.rgstr_date, s.cnt, s.previous, ( SELECT ocolt.resource_new_size_type2 FROM om_cloud_optimizer_log_tbl ocolt WHERE TO_DATE(s.rgstr_date::text, 'YYYYMMDD') >= ocolt.rgstr_dt::date AND ( CASE WHEN s.previous IS NOT NULL THEN TO_DATE(s.previous::text, 'YYYYMMDD') < ocolt.rgstr_dt::date ELSE TRUE END ) and resource_no = #{resource_no} ORDER BY ocolt.rgstr_dt DESC LIMIT 1 ) as size2 FROM Subquery s GROUP BY s.rgstr_date, s.previous, s.cnt;
